subject: [PATCH v6 06/19] selftests/mm: stop khugepaged during the MADV_COLLAPSE cases

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file to ensure that khugepaged is stopped during MADV_COLLAPSE cases. The problem it solves is that khugepaged was interfering with the test cases by collapsing the very range being tested, causing the tests to fail. To fix this, the patch clears per-order controls in addition to global controls, as MADV_COLLAPSE does not consult these settings. This change ensures that the test cases can run reliably and accurately test the behavior of khugepaged.
